welcomeText:
Rain Moth Gallery is a volunteer-run community art space in a stone villa on Peake Terrace, Waikerie, a short walk from the River Murray. Two intimate exhibition rooms host a changing program of local and regional art, alongside a gift shop of work by local makers.

We also run demonstrations and workshops for adults and children, and we're a tourist information outlet, so drop in to plan your walk along the Waikerie art trail.
